copy.title: Bananas Are Berries Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Funny Fruit Fact Tee, Botany Lover Gift
copy.description:
A medal-winning banana celebrates while a surprised strawberry checks its reflection. Bright cartoon characters and the message Bananas Are Berries. Strawberries Are Not. turn a surprising plant fact into a cheerful conversation starter for science fans, biology teachers, and fruit lovers.

In botany, bananas are classified as berries. Strawberries are aggregate accessory fruits, so they do not meet the botanical definition of a berry.

copy.title: A Day on Venus Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Golden Planet Graphic Tee, Astronomy Lover Gift
copy.description:
Golden Venus artwork pairs with the surprising message A Day on Venus Is Longer Than a Year on Venus. A conversation-starting design for astronomy fans, science teachers, and anyone fascinated by our solar system.

THE FACT BEHIND THE DESIGN
The slogan refers to one full rotation of Venus, its sidereal day, which takes about 243 Earth days. A Venus year takes about 225 Earth days. Sunrise to sunrise is a different measure, about 117 Earth days.
